title: 第一卷 第23章 宴山有走蛟第一卷 第24章 饕餮盛宴
content_zh:
从光门迈出的一瞬间，一股湿热的气息扑面而来。
林罪抬头打量四周。
到处都是参天大树，枝叶无比茂盛，遮天蔽日，阳光都透不进来。
地面上长满了藤蔓和杂草，有些比人还高，密密麻麻地纠缠在一起，视线最多只能看到几米开外。
脚踩在地上是软的，腐叶积了不知多少年。
他想起前世在电视上看过的那些漫剧，镜头里的树林永远只有大树和干净的林间小道。
现在看来，要多假有多假。
真正的原始山林就是这样。
阴暗，潮湿，逼仄，寸步难行。
普通人在原始山林面前，实在是过于渺小。
身后的杂役弟子，大部分出身都不太好，对此也见怪不怪。
沈清河最后一个从光门里走出来，光门在他身后消散。
他从怀里掏出一叠符纸，每人发了一张。
符纸只有巴掌大小，朱红色的线条勾勒出奇异的纹路。
“这张符，每人一张，能用三次，一次可以隔绝你们的气息五个时辰。”
“记住，隔绝气息不代表妖兽看不到你们，只是闻不到你们，该躲还得躲，该跑还得跑。”
他的目光扫视了所有人一眼，“建议在晚上用，夜晚，比白昼危险十几倍。”
“要是白天把次数用光了，晚上你们就能体验到什么是绝望，到时候别怪我没提醒你们。”
“三天后，捏碎符箓，你们会被传送到这个地方，我来接你们，一起回宗门。”
话音刚落，天色忽然暗了下来。

原本透过树木缝隙还能看到天空，太阳。
但是此刻，就像是傍晚一样。
林罪抬头往上看，前世他见过这种天色。
通常是在下午，大暴雨来临之前天边会先黑一块，然后迅速蔓延过来。
每到这种时候，要是不上学，他都会早早上床，盖好被子，好好的睡一觉。
但现在是早上，太阳才刚升起来没多久。
他微微皱眉，似乎不太对劲。
沈清河也仰头看了看天色，眉头皱了一下。
他拍了拍手，“行了，别发呆了，三人一队，也可以单独行动，记住，黑麟蛇的巢穴大多分布在岩石缝隙或枯树洞里，出发吧。”
话音落下，徐二狗凑上前，“林罪，咱们组个队咋样？”
“不了”，林罪握紧砍刀，往深处走去。
徐二狗在身后喊了两声，见林罪没理他，暗骂了几声。
content_en:
The moment he stepped out of the light door, a warm and moist breath hit his face.
Lin Zui raised his head and looked around.
There are towering trees everywhere, with extremely lush branches and leaves, blocking the sky and preventing sunlight from getting through.
The ground was covered with vines and weeds, some of which were taller than people. They were so densely intertwined that one could only see a few meters away at most.
The ground is soft under your feet, and the rotten leaves have accumulated for countless years.
He thought of those cartoons he had watched on TV in his previous life. The woods in the shots always only had big trees and clean forest paths.
Now it seems that the more lies there are, the more lies there are.
This is the real primitive mountain forest.
Dark, damp, cramped, and difficult to move.
Ordinary people are too insignificant in front of the primitive mountains and forests.
Most of the handyman disciples behind him were from poor backgrounds, so this was not surprising.
Shen Qinghe was the last to walk out of the light door, and the light door dissipated behind him.
He took out a stack of talisman papers from his arms and handed one to each person.
The talisman paper is only the size of a palm, and the vermilion lines outline strange patterns.
"This talisman, one for each person, can be used three times. It can isolate your breath for five hours at a time."
"Remember, isolating the breath doesn't mean that the monsters can't see you, it just can't smell you. You have to hide when you need to, and run when you need to run."
He glanced at everyone and said, "It is recommended to use it at night. It is ten times more dangerous than during the day."
"If you use up all the times during the day, you will be able to experience what despair is at night. Don't blame me for not reminding you then."
"After three days, crush the talisman and you will be transported to this place. I will pick you up and return to the sect together."
As soon as he finished speaking, the sky suddenly darkened.
Originally, the sky and the sun could still be seen through the gaps in the trees.
But right now, it's like evening.
Lin Zui raised his head and looked up. He had seen this kind of sky in his previous life.
Usually in the afternoon, before a heavy rainstorm comes, the sky will be dark at first, and then spread quickly.
Every time like this, if he didn't go to school, he would go to bed early, cover himself with a quilt, and have a good sleep.
But it was morning now, and the sun had only just risen.
He frowned slightly, something seemed wrong.
Shen Qinghe also looked up at the sky and frowned.
He clapped his hands and said, "Okay, don't be in a daze. You can work in a team of three, or you can act alone. Remember, most of the black snake's nests are located in rock crevices or dead tree holes. Let's go."
After the words fell, Xu Ergou stepped forward and said, "Lin Zui, how about we form a team?"
"No," Lin Zui tightened his grip on the machete and walked deeper.
Xu Ergou shouted twice behind him, and when Lin Zui ignored him, he cursed a few times.
